6	## 2026-08-29 — Native plan-and-self-review step for hard-task design rounds, not superpowers:writing-plans
7	Context: asked to have planner-architect use the `superpowers:brainstorming`/`writing-plans`
8	skills for complex tasks (write a plan, self-review it, hand it to the engine).
9	Decision: build the same rigor (numbered plan, self-review for coverage/placeholders/
10	consistency/scope/ambiguity) directly into `design-round`'s procedure instead of invoking those
11	skills. Two reasons: (1) `superpowers:brainstorming` hard-gates on human approval before any
12	implementation step — incompatible with an unattended pipeline run; (2) both skills are
13	machine-local plugins, not committed to this repo, so referencing them would silently no-op on
14	every cloud routine run (the pipeline's primary execution mode).
15	Consequences: the plan-and-self-review discipline now runs identically local or cloud, with no
16	external dependency. If those skills are ever made repo-portable and their approval gate made
17	optional for headless use, this can be revisited.
18	
19	## 2026-09-06 — Model policy: cheap implementer, heavy planner and reviewer
20	Context: the owner wants token spend cut without losing quality. Previously `classify` sent
21	hard tasks to an opus or fable *engine*; sonnet/haiku only implemented easier tiers. Reviewer
22	and QA models were fixed by frontmatter/profile, so the `deep`/`max` profile could silently put
23	browser-qa on opus.
24	Decision: split the pick in two. `engineModel` is haiku (trivial) or sonnet (everything else,
25	hard included) — never opus/fable. `planModel` is opus (explicit spec) or fable (thin spec) and
26	drives the design round, the replan, and code-reviewer. Every design round now produces a
27	full implementation plan (previously hard-only), explicit enough that sonnet executes it
28	rather than reasoning it out. test-qa-engine and browser-qa are always sonnet; the CTO gate
29	is pinned to opus in the workflow (never fable). The orchestrator passes every model
30	explicitly. Revisits 2026-08-29: `superpowers:writing-plans` may be used for the plan when it
31	is present in the skill listing (local runs); the native a–c step remains the cloud fallback.
32	`superpowers:brainstorming` stays excluded — its human-approval gate is still incompatible
33	with unattended runs.
34	Consequences: opus/fable spend moves from implementation (the longest stage) to two short
35	stages (plan, review). Plan quality is now load-bearing for hard tasks — a thin plan will
36	show up as sonnet build failures and verify fix-cycles, which is the signal to fix the plan,
37	not to raise the engine model.
38
